name: How do you handle interior connections in older Salt Lake City homes?

mainEntity.name: How do you handle interior connections in older Salt Lake City homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Connecting additions to older properties, such as historic homes in Salt Lake City neighborhoods like Sugar House, The Avenues, or Harvard-Yale, involves managing legacy construction methods. These older homes frequently feature lath-and-plaster walls, non-standard framing dimensions, and settle-induced floor level variations. Blue Lake Construction addresses these challenges by custom-shimming subfloors for smooth transitions, matching historic trim profiles, and carefully joining modern drywall with existing plaster walls to prevent future cracking.
acceptedAnswer.description: We manage lath-and-plaster walls, true up uneven floor heights, and match custom historic millwork found in historic Salt Lake neighborhoods.
